findings.text: The adoption predicate the node was dispatched to fix is untouched: the five named stubs (line_averaged_neon_density, radius_of_soft_xray_detector, ratio_of_diamagnetic_vorticity_to_major_radius, toroidal_coordinate_of_spectrometer, toroidal_tritium_velocity) still have no demonstrated path to composition, and the node's own fragment records that the cause was not established, so the node goal is not delivered.

_UNOWNED_PENDING_PROJECTION restates the unowned-pending-projection eligibility already owned at graph_source_bindings.py:1009-1028 instead of extending it, and the copy drops that owner's unit-agreement check while graph_supersession.py:265 passes enforce_consistency=False, so the two predicates can drift and the migration path is left without the unit guard.

test_two_path_projection_stub_is_adopted and test_structural_parent_projection_stub_is_adopted (line 226) both pass on the c59ac227a base arm per receipt-base-graph.log, so they are regression coverage rather than the main-failing negative controls the brief required; only test_second_claim_after_unpark_finalizes reddens on main.

justifications.durability: tests/standard_names/test_compose_adopts_pending_stub.py:212 and :226 pass on the c59ac227a base arm, and the adoption-escape removal at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_catalog.py:2459 has no assertion that reddens if it is restored.
justifications.evidence: receipt-base-graph.log and receipt-head-graph.log are complete with revision headers and EXIT lines, but the base arm fails only 1 of the 18 cases, so three of the four mandated new cases are not the main-failing evidence the done_when requires.
justifications.fit: The added names (_UNOWNED_PENDING_PROJECTION, projection_stub, _projection_stub_source_bindings) describe the mechanism, and every commit carries a conventional subject with a body and no attribution trailer.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_source_bindings.py:1009-1028 still carries the adoption predicate unchanged, so none of the five named stubs is made composable.
justifications.reuse: imas_codex/standard_names/provenance_lifecycle.py:505-520 is a second definition of the unowned-pending-projection predicate the repository already owns at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_source_bindings.py:1009-1028, and it does not extend that owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every changed path in the diff is inside the grant widened by resume-1-advice.txt, and no plan, index or production graph was written.
